name: Rusalka
description: A female water spirit in East and West Slavic folklore, often understood as the restless soul of a drowned woman or unbaptized girl, who lures men into rivers and lakes during a seasonal week of activity around Pentecost.

aliases.name: Mavka
aliases.meaning: forest/water spirit, partly synonymous with rusalka

origin: Widely attested across the East Slavic world (Russia, Ukraine, Belarus) and into Poland, Czech and Slovak lands; secondary attestations in Slovenia and parts of the Balkans.
